model_contract.element: linear tetrahedral TET4; six-tet cube split copied from the frozen AJ fixture
model_contract.support: zero ux, uy, uz on every top-boundary node
model_contract.master: one fixed rigid planar triangular patch at z=0 m; normal +z; frozen geometry
model_contract.contact: frictionless unilateral Signorini; one normal constraint at every bottom node; no edge/corner, finite sliding, self-contact, or deformable master
model_contract.reaction: lambda>=0 N; force on slave body is +lambda e_z
model_contract.biactive_front: g=lambda=0 in the continuum at x=0.5 m; nodal classification is not forced at this line
model_contract.loads: unchanged analytic body forces and noncontact boundary tractions from the AJ fixture
model_contract.voigt: [epsilon_xx, epsilon_yy, epsilon_zz, gamma_xy, gamma_yz, gamma_xz], engineering shear; D shear entries=mu
model_contract.energy: U=0.5 integral(epsilon^T D epsilon)dV; energy error norm=sqrt(integral(delta_epsilon^T D delta_epsilon)dV), units sqrt(J)

mesh_family.construction: nx=2k, ny=k, nz=k; same physical domain, same structured cells, same six-tet local split, same boundary and load rules
mesh_family.h_max_m: 3/nx, largest tetrahedral edge for this cell aspect ratio and split
mesh_family.nesting: M1-M2 has aligned node nesting; M2-M3-M4-M5 are not nested; compare fields with the analytic continuum and never by nodal index
mesh_family.front_alignment: x=0.5 m remains an x-cell boundary at each level; this family does not test a misaligned continuum front

frozen_aj_acceptance_gates.scope: exact AJ test assertions applied at each of M1-M3; AJ coarse/fine endpoint is M1/M3, not M1/M5
frozen_aj_acceptance_gates.partial_contact_counts: 0 < active_count < contact_rows and open_count > 0 at each level
frozen_aj_acceptance_gates.contact_force_and_moment_errors: must be finite and reported; no discretization error threshold in AJ
frozen_aj_acceptance_gates.front_metrics: must be finite and reported; no front acceptance threshold in AJ

proposed_ar_endpoint_gates_require_owner.note: same numeric thresholds as AJ, but extending the fine endpoint from M3 to M5 is prospective AR policy, not a historical frozen AJ result; no strict adjacent-level monotonicity gate

proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.classification: prospective benchmark-specific empirical criterion; not a frozen AJ criterion or general theorem
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.biactive_node: record both gap and lambda against their frozen absolute tolerances; do not force an active/open label at x=0.5 m
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.row_front: per y row, largest x with lambda > force tolerance; also record first open x, adjacent gaps/multipliers, and bracket width
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.front_distance: D_front,max=max_y(abs(x_h(y)-0.5 m)); report m and D_front,max/hx; equivalent to Hausdorff distance for this straight full-width front when all y rows are represented
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.spatial_locality_gate: every false-positive or false-negative node is within hx of x=0.5 m
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.coverage_gate: every y row has interpretable active and open states and a front bracket; no row may be silently excluded
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.M1_policy: report only; its zero physical error is an alignment/biactivity alias and cannot anchor front trend
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.area_mismatch: diagnostic only; do not gate monotonicity of lumped nodal-tributary mismatch
proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_ap.interpretation: bounded one-cell localization over this structured mesh family; not asymptotic convergence, not a general free-boundary theorem

measurement_protocol.displacement: integrate FE interpolation error against the exact continuum field on each mesh; relative L2 and absolute norm
measurement_protocol.pressure: derive nodal pressure lambda/tributary area; interpolate on the bottom triangles and integrate squared error against exact pressure; same physical domain and exact denominator per mesh
measurement_protocol.energy: report FE 0.5*u^T*K*u, independently quadrature-integrated FE energy, exact continuum energy, absolute energy error, and energy-error norm in sqrt(J)
measurement_protocol.front: record every row, last active, first open, biactive rows, bracket width, physical and hx-normalized error, false-positive/negative coordinates and distance to front
measurement_protocol.mechanics: all-row independent QP KKT residuals, primal/dual feasibility, complementarity, force/moment balance, contact resultant/moment and analytic support-reaction comparison
measurement_protocol.nonnested_comparison: primary errors use continuum exact fields on each mesh; any direct inter-mesh field difference must use a fixed common physical quadrature/grid and interpolate each FE solution there
measurement_protocol.observed_orders: report pairwise log(error ratio)/log(mesh-size ratio) for positive measured errors; label apparent only, report interval and nonmonotone signs, no asymptotic claim from five levels

capacity_blocker.authorization_required: explicit source/capacity and numerical-resource authorization plus a fresh source/test/runner/manifest freeze before any COLLECT or RUN

manifest_metadata_correction.handling: historical AJ manifest immutable; all prospective manifests must use 18 and recalculate M1 KKT dimension accordingly

authorizations.unit_tests: authorized, but no new numerical/scientific tests were run in this protocol-only work
authorizations.collect: not authorized for this prepared M4/M5 identity
